Shading bids only risks losing profitable wins; overbidding risks negative payoff. No prior history to adjust beliefs, so submit bid = 15.0.]

[This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction with independent private values. Bidding your true value is a weakly dominant strategy: it maximizes expected profit because if you win you pay the second-highest bid which is below your value. Values are redrawn independently, so no strategic shading helps. Tie-breaking is random but bidding truthfully remains optimal. I will bid my private value to maximize expected surplus: win when price <47 and realize positive profit.]
